name: Sota Kobayashi
source:
Massage Style: Shiatsu
Likes: Kovit, Money, Studying
Dislikes: Remi, Cheapskates

(Kickstarter)
A young, cheerful, and hyperactive masseur. He studies in the morning and works as a masseur at night. He is actually the eldest of 11 children who takes care of their single mother and feels the pressure of making as much money as possible. He takes his masseur job very seriously and is willing to do anything to get more cash from it.

The youngest masseur working at Full Service Spa. During the day, he attends the Morningwood University as a student. He loves making profits, and hopes to earn a lot of money once he finishes college. He has a habit of offering extra services just to squeeze out even more money from his customers.

(Facebook)
A cheerful and hyperactive kid that easily gets excited about money. Sota is the youngest masseur in Full Service Spa and will do everything for tips to improve his performance so he can collect more cash.

At daytime, he studies at Morningwood University. Being the eldest among 11 siblings, he had to take the responsibility of being the provider of his family.
